item.title: Fans flock to auction to dish out big bucks for Colonel Sanders' items
item.description: Appalachia Mid-South Newsroom's Andrew Henderson went to an auction of items belonged by Harland Sanders, known as Colonel Sanders, to understand why people are so fascinated by the founder of KFC.

item.title: Understanding the tech giants' oversized influence in American schools
item.description: Big tech companies like Apple and Microsoft use devices, training and conferences for teachers and students to embed in schools. The New York Times' Natasha Singer discusses the impact in Coding Kids.

item.title: Greetings from the Royal Pavilion, a stunning reminder of India in southern England
item.description: Looking up at this 18th century building, it became clear the British didn't only bring their architectural style to India. They also took some of India's style home.
item.content:encoded: Looking up at this 18th century building, it became clear the British didn't only bring their architectural style to India. They also took some of India's style home.

item.title: Milwaukee's Veggie Chop Shop uses farmers' excess produce to feed those in need
item.description: A program called the Veggie Chop Shop enlists volunteers to gather extra produce from farmers' markets that would otherwise go to waste. They then cook meals for people facing food insecurity.
item.content:encoded: A program called the Veggie Chop Shop enlists volunteers to gather extra produce from farmers' markets that would otherwise go to waste. They then cook meals for people facing food insecurity.

item.title: Metropolitan Museum of Art cancels John Galliano exhibit and Met Gala theme
item.description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art will no longer honor famed fashion designer John Galliano with a career retrospective. Neither will he be celebrated at this year's Met Gala.

item.title: Amid backlash, museum cancels planned Met Gala exhibit on fashion designer John Galliano
item.description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art is canceling exhibit honoring British designer John Galliano. The exhibit had led to backlash because of the designer's past antisemitic and racist statements.

item.title: How the producer of 'Fleabag' creates hits at the Fringe
item.description: Before Baby Reindeer or Fleabag made it to the screen, they were small theater productions at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. And behind both is a producer you've probably never heard of.

item.title: Paperwork, lines, hours on hold: There's a 'Time Tax' on Americans who need help most
item.description: Annie Lowrey explores the administrative burdens people face applying for government benefits. It's not just about wasted time: "When the government treats us like this, we don't trust it," she says.
